name: Project Context page lists the fixture docs; a seeded run's trace shows Specs read and the attached-specs prompt block
description: From the PR list, follows the sidebar's 'Project Context' entry (nav.ts row, AC-4) to /repos/:repoId/context and confirms both L05 seed fixture docs (specs/overview.md, docs/architecture.md) render in the list, plus the fixture doc matched only by configured file name (INSIGHTS.md, badged 'insights' rather than a root — AC-27/AC-36), then selects the overview doc and confirms its rendered Markdown preview (AC-6). Returns to the PR list via the sidebar, opens PR #482's Agent runs tab, and opens the trace drawer for the seeded 'General Reviewer' run (server/src/db/seed.ts's L05 fixture: an agent_runs row with a non-empty specs_read + prompt_assembly.specs). Confirms the Configuration card's 'Specs read' row lists both attached paths (AC-22) and, after expanding Prompt assembly, the attached-specs block's label (AC-23). Deterministic locators only, no chat, no model call — everything here is seeded read-only data.
